- INV-00119: Rohan Naik

2. ["INV-00119", "INV-00120", "INV-00121", "INV-00143"] - includes Rohan Naik, Yash Nair, Diya Ghosh, Ira Nair

- It only includes 3 invoices instead of 4
- It doesn't match all 4 students mentioned in the payment notes
- This makes it LESS valid than the accepted explanation

The second alternative includes Ira Nair, who is not mentioned in the payment notes.
